title: chart-radial-01
description: Delivery progress · Q2 2026. 78 of 100 planned releases shipped this quarter.

meta.prompt:
Create a responsive analytics card titled “Quarterly goal” with the muted eyebrow “Delivery progress · Q2 2026”. Fill available width up to 576px. Use a theme-aware card surface, rounded border, an 18px title, a prominent 30px semibold metric with tabular numerals, and a separated muted footer.

Show a clockwise circular progress arc starting at the top on a full-circle background track, with rounded ends and a hidden 0–100 scale. Use a 35% inner radius and 90% outer radius. Show Platform at 78%, a Platform legend and tooltip, a 78% headline, and a footer stating 78 of 100 planned releases shipped this quarter.

Keep the plot 260px tall and responsive to the card width. Provide accessible chart navigation and value tooltips.

Build the chart with TanStack Charts. Use responsive chart geometry, theme-aware chart colors, a labeled legend, and pointer and keyboard value tooltips.
